sources.title: SlayerLab/Slayer149-Balanced-ARC-E-ft-45500 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Slayer149 Balanced — ARC-Easy fine-tune (seed 45500) A full-weight ARC-Easy fine-tune of the 149,333,081-parameter Slayer149 Balanced checkpoint at step 45,500. This repository contains the predeclared primary seed (45500), selected at epoch 3 by validation accuracy. It is a research artifact for inspection and reproduction, not a general-purpose instruction model.
